description: Na₅InO₄ is Ilmenite-like structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmmn space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent InO₄ tetrahedra, corners with eight equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one InO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.48 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent InO₄ tetrahedra, corners with eight equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and edges with four equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are two shorter (2.28 Å) and two longer (2.32 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In is bonded to four O atoms to form InO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with eight equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and edges with four equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are two shorter (2.07 Å) and two longer (2.09 Å) In-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one In atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₅In octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 60-64°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one In atom.
